name: horizontal-scroll

frames.best_why: The full coral panel is in frame, the giant black PASSION word is unclipped and the team photo sits beneath it.

tagline: Giant colour words sweep across the screen as the page scrolls down.
summary: Full-screen colour panels, one per word, slide sideways as you scroll. Each panel carries an enormous black word across its middle and a small square photo of people working at the bottom edge.
appearance: Full-height panels in coral red, blue, orange, yellow and green, each filled by a huge black word such as PASSION or WORK and a small square team photo resting at the bottom edge. A dark grid hero sits above the panels.
behaviour: Scrolling down pushes the row of panels leftwards, so each full-screen colour enters from the right as the previous one leaves. Inside a panel the big word drifts a little slower than the panel itself, and the row ends after the last colour.
demo_content: Words PASSION and WORK with team photos of people around a table and at laptops.
search_phrases: full screen colour panels with giant text
page that moves sideways with big words
one word per screen on scroll
bold typographic page that moves sideways
use_when: A manifesto or campaign page wants bold one-word statements that travel sideways with the scroll.
avoid_when: The section runs five screens tall with no skip control, and every word, colour and photo is hard-coded.
customise: No props: the five words, their background colours and photo links sit in the panels array, and the section height and word size are classes in the source.
weight_why: Five small photos and a scroll handler that only rewrites transforms.

a11y.note: Photos carry alt text, but the sideways motion ignores reduced-motion and there is no way to skip the five-screen section.

issues: Giant words are clipped at the panel edges mid-travel, so PASSION briefly reads as SSION.
The section is five screens tall before the next content, with no skip control.
Panels sit edge to edge, so the word and the photo fight for the same space on narrow screens.
polish_why: Bold type and confident colour panels; words clip at slide edges and there is no way past.
title: Horizontal Scroll
